purpose: Diagnostic native summary controls, excluded from task scores and latency aggregates.
runtime: Same pinned MLX Swift LM backend as Sillies, bypassing app orchestration, output parsing, storage and UI.
tokenCountNote: Native token stream counts include the terminating token; they can differ by one from helper completion metrics.

diagnosticAppRuns.purpose: Initial integration changes before the larger summary allowance; negative controls retained.
One corrected-code replay per model with the summary allowance; not pooled into scored results.

streamBoundaryProbe.limitations: Unseeded production-runtime probes of one request; this does not establish universal framing reliability.

failedPrimaryReviews.note: No final answer. The model repeatedly read the beginning using the record title instead of recovery-topic keywords, omitted recordID on one call, received a structured correction, then exhausted the 1,264-token generation budget entirely in reasoning. The requested identifier was not retrieved.
Acknowledges the name as recorded without invoking save_memory; persisted memory remains empty.
Creates user_name=Sol while leaving the existing name=Nora intact, instead of replacing the existing memory. The resulting store contains conflicting current identities.
Correctly reports an unknown address, but performs a Vault lookup outside this frozen task’s allowed memory/conversation routing contract. This is not an invented-address failure.
Correctly identifies a saved screenshot, then falsely concludes it is whatever the user is looking at right now. Retrieved saved evidence cannot establish live screen state.
Replies "You can call me Imani!": confuses whose name Imani is and violates the name-only request. No additional write occurs.
Uses Pogo correctly but adds prose despite the explicit name-only request; Imani remains stored as the human name.

No answer before the unchanged 60-second turn deadline. The stage journal shows two history summaries reaching the 2,368-token ceiling (about 24.6 and 25.6 seconds), then a final reply starting before termination. This remains an app/model budget and fallback interaction, not an established model-only failure.
Makes no memory write and answers the length question, but unnecessarily repeats the supplied password in its closing advice, violating the explicit secret-handling rubric.
Keeps the correct companion identity Pogo and does not change memory, but adds "I’m" despite the explicit name-only request.
Claims to have the human name recorded but performs no save; the required persisted Alex fact is absent.

Names Pacific correctly but falsely says its surface area exceeds all other oceans combined. NOAA reports about 45% of ocean area (https://www.noaa.gov/jetstream/ocean). A matching answer word does not excuse the incorrect supporting claim.
Uses private Vault searches for a general Moon question and incorrectly says the Moon does not rotate in sync with its orbit while calling it tidally locked.

Does not retrieve quartz-73. Repeatedly reads the beginning or overlapping offsets instead of using recovery keywords/returned continuation offsets, then incorrectly describes partial passage coverage as incomplete transcription or unavailable complete content.
Acknowledges Taylor but performs no save; the required durable human-name fact is absent.

Correctly reports no matching meeting, but claims to have searched personal memories and found none about this topic without any search_memories call. Vault categories do not cover the separate memory store; this supporting search claim is unsupported.
Creates user_name=Sol but leaves name=Nora intact. The required replacement did not occur and the store contains conflicting current names.
Admits the address is unknown, but uses Vault outside the frozen task’s allowed tools and claims to have searched previous chats despite no conversation-search call.
Replies 0 to the number of sides of a triangle; expected 3. No tool or retrieval was involved.
No answer: final generation exhausted its 1264-token ceiling entirely in reasoning after unrelated empty private searches. The later correction was not answered.
Does not recall Mina; searches repeatedly for release code instead of checklist owner and treats conversation facts as unverified because the Vault is empty.

Names axial tilt but explicitly claims the Southern Hemisphere tilts toward the Sun in June and away in December, the same seasonal pattern it gives for the Northern Hemisphere. This contradicts the requested opposite-seasons explanation; lexical anchors missed it.
Performs no write but unnecessarily repeats the fictional password, contrary to the explicit full-rubric requirement.
Answers the correct country with a sentence instead of the explicitly requested country-only output.
Mina is present in the retained summary and even quoted in the response, but the model refuses to use it because Vault searches are empty. Does not satisfy the requested name-only recall.

Names the Pacific correctly but supports the answer with a tenfold area conversion error: 63 million square miles is about 163 million square kilometres, not 16 million. This is a material false supporting quantitative claim; the literal Pacific anchor misses it.
